B01: Accepted bytes round-trip exactly and successful writes leave no temporary objects.
B02: Digest mismatch, truncation and excess bytes do not publish an object.
B03: Declared object lengths above the configured maximum are rejected.
B04: Equal retries succeed and a different original cannot replace an existing key.
B05: Concurrent writes of the same bytes are idempotent.
B06: Empty objects remain distinguishable from missing objects.
B07: Stalled upload cancellation publishes no object and cleans temporary storage.
B08: Object keys are restricted to the immutable assets/originals namespaces.
